review_candidates.description: ¿ Quiénes somos? Importante grupo multinacional líder en la fabricación de productos industriales, con presencia consolidada a nivel global, en más de 190 países y una fuerte apuesta por el crecimiento en Europa. En este contexto, la compañía está desarrollando un proyecto estratégico de gran impacto: la puesta en marcha de su sede europea en Barcelona, con el objetivo de ofrecer soporte integral y acompañamiento a su red de distribuidores en el mercado europeo para el incremento de las ventas en toda Europa. ¿Qué buscamos, puedes ser tu? Buscamos un perfil con capacidad para entender producto, mercado y cliente, y transformar ese conocimiento en propuestas de valor, materiales comerciales y acciones de marketing que ayuden a acelerar el negocio en Europa. Es una posición especialmente orientada a marketing técnico B2B, con fuerte interacción con equipos internacionales y foco en sectores como HVAC, climatización industrial y soluciones técnicas para aplicaciones profesionales. La misión principal será traducir la propuesta de valor de las soluciones industriales en mensajes, materiales y acciones de marketing útiles para la red comercial, distribuidores y clientes profesionales, contribuyendo al crecimiento y consolidación de la marca en el mercado europeo. Las principales responsabilidades serán: Desarrollar la propuesta de valor de producto y convertirla en mensajes claros, diferenciales y adaptados al mercado. Crear y adaptar materiales de marketing y ventas: presentaciones, fichas de producto, catálogos, argumentarios, vídeos, animaciones y soportes para lanzamientos. Coordinar y ejecutar acciones de marketing de producto y trade marketing, con foco en un entorno principalmente offline. Dar soporte a lanzamientos de producto y a iniciativas de activación comercial en coordinación con los equipos de negocio. Gestionar la participación en ferias, eventos y exposiciones internacionales: planificación, coordinación de materiales, montaje, promoción y seguimiento. Generar contenido y casos de éxito a partir de proyectos de referencia para reforzar la credibilidad y notoriedad de la marca. Trabajar de forma estrecha con equipos de producto, negocio y stakeholders internacionales para asegurar coherencia de mensaje y alineación estratégica. Entender las necesidades del cliente y del mercado para trasladarlas a argumentarios, materiales y herramientas comerciales de valor. Apoyar a la red comercial y de distribución en la adaptación del mensaje a distintos interlocutores y tipologías de cliente. Requisitos Formación universitaria en Ingeniería, ADE o similar. Experiencia mínima de 3-5 años en posiciones de marketing B2B, marketing de producto o trade marketing. Experiencia previa imprescindible en entornos industriales o técnicos, idealmente vinculados a HVAC, climatización, bombas de calor, energía o soluciones técnicas similares. Conocimiento del canal B2B y de clientes como ingenierías, grandes instaladores, cadenas hoteleras, cadenas de retail/supermercados o cuentas industriales. Experiencia en gestión de ferias internacionales y acciones de visibilidad de marca. Experiencia trabajando con red comercial y/o distribuidores a nivel europeo. Perfil con buena base técnica y sensibilidad comercial, capaz de entender productos complejos y convertirlos en mensajes claros y útiles para negocio. Experiencia creando materiales de marketing y ventas orientados a clientes profesionales y canales de distribución. Capacidad para desenvolverse en entornos internacionales y matriciales, colaborando con interlocutores de diferentes países. Nivel alto de inglés, imprescindible para la interlocución con stakeholders internacionales. Perfil flexible, resolutivo y con autonomía. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Incorporación a un proyecto internacional, en una compañía líder y en plena fase de impulso y desarrollo en Europa. Posición con visibilidad, impacto real en negocio y contacto directo con equipos internacionales. Entorno dinámico, técnico y con recorrido profesional.

Reikalavimai komunikuosi su kuriamos IT sistemos veiklos (biometrinio pasirašymo planšetėse sistema) atstovais, planuosi ir nustatysi sistemos vystymo darbų prioritetus; bendrausi su visomis suinteresuotomis pusėmis dėl sistemos kūrimo, vystymo darbų eigos, valdysi darbų apimtis ir inicijuosi pokyčius, dalyvausi formuojant sistemos architektūrą; rengsi reikiamų IT pokyčių aprašymus (IT sistemų specifikacijų rengimas ir pan.), koordinuosi incidentų šalinimo darbus; siūlysi kaip tobulinti kuriamos IT sistemos procesus; planuosi IT sistemos biudžetą ir savalaikius pirkimus. Įmonė siūlo turi aukštąjį išsilavinimą; turi ne mažesnę nei 2 metų panašaus darbo patirtį su informacinėmis sistemomis (IT sistemų veikimo išmanymas, specifikavimas ir pan.); turi realios praktinės patirties darbuojantis su elektroniniais parašais, jų infrastruktūros išmanymu. Ypatingai vertintume patirtį susijusią su biometrinio parašo ypatumais: kriptografijos išmanymu, teisiniu reglamentavimu ir pan. išmanai veiklos procesų ir informacinių sistemų valdymo principus bei gebi identifikuoti ir formalizuoti reikalavimus sistemos funkcionalumams; turi bazines programavimo žinias; spręsi iškilusias problemas, analizuosi ir planuosi savo laiką pasižymi stipriu analitiniu mąstymu (ir gebėjimu aprašyti pageidaujamą sistemų funkcionalumą / reikalavimus), esi smalsus (-i) ir iniciatyvus (-i), gebi ne tik analizuoti duomenis, bet ir kelti klausimus, ieškoti įžvalgų; turi informacinių sistemų architektūros žinių. Architektūros išmanymas ir pažintis su sistemų kūrimo ypatumais būtų privalumas; turi darbo patirties su didelėmis valstybinės reikšmės informacinėmis sistemomis (IS): nuo poreikių surinkimo ir reikalavimų specifikavimo iki IS įsigijimo, t. y. viešųjų pirkimų proceso išmanymo iki naudojimo ir IS tobulinimo.

We're redefining what seamless connectivity abroad looks like, and the opportunity ahead is bigger than what we've built so far. About The Role Owner of Holafly's most important cross-functional initiatives, and the link between high-level goals and the day-to-day work that delivers them. Sitting within the PMO, this role runs projects across their full lifecycle - initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure - keeping them on scope, on time, and on budget while aligning different teams around a shared plan. It's a hands-on, senior role for someone who can walk into an ambiguous problem, get up to speed fast, and drive it forward without waiting to be told how - ruthlessly focused on what moves the needle and comfortable saying no to what doesn't. Key Responsibilities Own priority initiatives end-to-end across the full project lifecycle - from defining scope, goals, and deliverables through planning, execution, and clean closure. Manage scope and schedule: build realistic timelines and milestones, estimate and track resources, and hold the line against scope creep as things change. Prioritize ruthlessly - decide what matters most, in what order, and why, and keep the team focused there. Anticipate and manage risk: identify dependencies early, assign owners and concrete mitigations, and unblock or escalate before delivery is at stake. Align cross-functional teams across different areas around shared goals, timelines, and a clear definition of done; resolve conflicts and keep capacity balanced. Safeguard quality and make progress visible: set quality standards and governance, keep clear documentation, and give leadership honest, predictable updates on status, risks, and results. Requirements 4-8+ years in Project/Program Management, PMO, or Strategy, ideally within a digital product environment. Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional projects from initiation to closure - on scope, on time, and on budget - with minimal hand-holding. Solid command of core project management fundamentals: scope, schedule, budget, resource, and risk management, plus quality and governance. Self-sufficiency and strong judgment: you set your own priorities, make the call on what to cut, and know when to escalate. Adaptability under pressure - you stay calm and keep momentum when priorities shift or risks land at the worst moment. Having the ability to set priorities and guidance without direct authority. review_candidates.title: Regional CSA QA/QC Manager
review_candidates.description: Role Overview Provide regional quality leadership for Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) works across multiple data centre projects. Reporting to the Head of Quality, the role establishes consistent quality practices, checks their implementation through site audits and surveillance, and verifies that findings are properly closed. Work with project management, site QA/QC, engineering, package teams and subcontractors to prevent recurring defects, reduce rework and maintain the inspection and test evidence needed for area handover and project completion. Scope Cover CSA works and associated quality records across the assigned regional portfolio, including new build, fit-out and external works. Maintain inspection templates, audit arrangements and evidence requirements aligned with CTS procedures, approved designs and project specifications. Provide functional support to site QA/QC teams and intervene early where inspections, workmanship or closeout are falling short. Key CSA Experience Experience should cover the following areas, as applicable to the assigned project scope: Civil works: earthworks, formation and compaction, piling and foundations, underground drainage and services, roads, slabs and hardstanding. Concrete: reinforcement, cover, formwork, embedded items and anchor bolts, placement, compaction, curing, test records, surveys and controlled repairs. Structural works: steelwork and precast installation, connections, welding and bolting records, tolerances, grouting and protective coatings. Building envelope: roofing, cladding, waterproofing, insulation, air and vapour barriers, seals and specified performance testing. Architectural works: partitions, ceilings, doors, raised floors, floor finishes, coatings and workmanship standards. Passive fire protection: compartmentation, firestopping, fire doors and structural fire protection, including installation traceability and inspection before concealment. MEP interfaces: openings, penetrations, builders' work, equipment bases, access provisions, room condition and cleanliness for area handover. Key Accountabilities Own the regional CSA audit plan, with site visits and surveillance targeted at project risk, critical activities and recurring defects. Audit subcontractor quality plans, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and inspection arrangements to confirm they are in place before relevant work starts. Verify that site teams establish benchmarks and first-of-kind installations, obtain the required acceptance and use them to maintain workmanship standards. Check that hold and witness points are planned, notified and recorded, and that required releases are obtained from the authorised parties before work proceeds. Prioritise work that will become inaccessible, including concrete pours, backfilling, enclosed cavities, firestopping and building-envelope interfaces. Issue clear audit findings against the applicable requirements. Agree action owners and due dates and verify closeout using objective evidence. Challenge recurring defects and non-conformance reports (NCRs), require root-cause investigation and check that corrective actions prevent recurrence across projects. Escalate significant quality risks and overdue actions to project leadership and the Head of Quality. Recommend work holds where required under agreed project procedures. Check that project programmes allow time for inspections, internal and client walkdowns, snagging, repairs and verification before area handover. Report regional performance, repeat defects and emerging risks to the Head of Quality, with clear actions and support required. Core Responsibilities Run weekly or fortnightly quality reviews with site teams covering audit actions, NCRs, inspection status, upcoming hold points and handover constraints. Sample installed works against current issued-for-construction drawings, approved technical submittals, specifications and accepted benchmarks. Review material certification, delivery and storage controls, survey results, test records and equipment calibration, checking traceability to the work inspected. Verify that concrete defects, water ingress, coating failures and other non-conformities follow an agreed repair process, with required technical approvals and inspection evidence. Work with Mechanical and Electrical Quality Leads to check that shared interfaces and area handover requirements have clear inspection responsibilities. Review CSA handover records in ACC/BIM 360 or the project document system, including completed ITPs, test results, as-built records and relevant warranties. Coach site teams, share practical lessons and issue quality bulletins to improve inspection quality and prevent repeat problems. Role Interfaces and Authority The role provides regional assurance and functional guidance through project management and site QA/QC teams. Site teams and subcontractors remain responsible for carrying out the work, day-to-day inspections, corrective actions and maintaining their records. Design decisions, technical submittal approvals and acceptance of design changes or remedial solutions remain with the appointed engineering and approval authorities. Hold-point releases and client acceptance follow the agreed project procedures. The Regional CSA Quality Lead checks that the required approvals and evidence are in place and escalates unresolved concerns. Required Skills And Experience Degree or diploma in Civil or Structural Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical construction experience. Proven experience in a lead CSA QA/QC role on complex construction projects, with data centre or other mission-critical experience strongly preferred. Sound practical knowledge of civil, structural and architectural construction methods, workmanship standards, inspection requirements and common defects. Ability to interpret drawings, specifications and approved submittals, identify departures from requirements and support evidence-based resolution. Experience planning and conducting construction audits, investigating NCRs, verifying corrective actions and reporting trends across projects. Working knowledge of quality management systems and ISO 9001 principles. Internal or Lead Auditor training, or equivalent, is desirable. Confident using ACC/BIM 360 or equivalent systems for inspections, issues, document control and handover evidence. Clear communication and the confidence to challenge weak evidence, coach site teams and follow actions through to verified closure. Experience across multiple sites or international projects is desirable, with flexibility to travel frequently across the assigned region, including Scandinavia Measures of Success Audit actions and NCRs closed within agreed dates, supported by verified evidence. Fewer repeat defects and improved inspection acceptance at the first submission. Required inspections and hold-point releases completed before works are covered or progressed. Complete, traceable CSA handover records and fewer outstanding quality issues at area handover.
